title: Meta is back with Muse Glimmer: local, agentic, multimodal, and open source
summary: Meta's Muse Glimmer is an open-source, local-first AI model that combines agentic behavior with multimodal capabilities, enabling on-device reasoning across text, images, and audio. It emphasizes privacy, offline functionality, and customization, positioning itself as a lightweight alternative to cloud-based assistants.
